Both areas' bench walks saw it. The cause: packages/runtime/src/daemon/pull-requests.ts docsTitle compared the branch with DOCS_SCAFFOLD_BRANCH only. The fix: docsTitle now reads isScaffoldBranch, which l4-github-link exports from loop/docs.ts. The test, written first and failing before the fix ('The project's docs from the plan'), is in apps/ui/test/real-daemon.test.ts, describe 'l4-github-link, run L4', case 'merge L4e (L4-github-102 with pull-requests.ts) ...'. It seeds a repository whose old fr/docs-scaffold names a third project and whose pull request was closed. It checks that Take it over opens exactly one pull request, on fr/docs-scaffold-kite-flyers, and that GET /projects/:id/pull-requests lists that pull request as "The project's standard docs", also after the daemon starts again. The fake daemon has no such mapping, so it needed no change. docs/maintainers/runtime.md now says so.

(2) packages/runtime/test/writing-rules.test.ts: the L4-github-108 sweep had left out join-words.ts until l4-github-merge fixed L4-github-113. That fix is now merged, so the exclusion is dropped and the sweep covers every file. This makes the test stronger. I checked it: putting the old '"${keep}"'s setting' back into settingAppliesLine fails the sweep at join-words.ts:187, and the source was restored afterwards.
